correctness.rationale: The source update is exactly linear on \(h(x)=\tfrac12x^\top Hx\). Orthogonal diagonalization gives the modal polynomial \(r^2-(1-\beta\lambda+m_\lambda)r+m_\lambda\), \(m_\lambda=\alpha-\theta\lambda\). The three degree-two Jury inequalities reduce exactly to \(|m_\lambda|<1\), \(\beta\lambda>0\), and \(\beta\lambda<2(1+m_\lambda)\). Endpoint monotonicity proves the robust iff statement, and the discriminant plus root sum/product proves every root-geometry branch. The packaged numerical replay is only a consistency check.

value.rationale: The source explicitly motivates Hessian correction by stability and oscillation reduction. The exact SPD phase diagram gives a usable parameter law: the correction decreases momentum with curvature, removes complex roots only in a precisely identified region, produces an alternating mode after \(\theta\lambda>\alpha\), and reduces the sharp robust step budget via \(\beta+2\theta\). This distinguishes beneficial damping from overcorrection and quantifies how far the source sufficient nonlinear region is from exact quadratic stability.
